# IPTV Brampton Canada

> IPTV Brampton Canada is a top-rated IPTV service provider based in Brampton, Ontario, Canada. We deliver 25,000+ live channels, 70,000+ movies and series, and 4K streaming quality to subscribers across Brampton, Mississauga, Toronto, Hamilton, Ottawa and all of Ontario.

## About

IPTV Brampton Canada has been serving Canadian households since 2016. Our service runs on high-capacity Canadian servers for buffer-free streaming. We offer instant activation via WhatsApp, 24/7 bilingual support, and compatibility with every popular IPTV player and device.

## Key Facts

- 25,000+ live channels including Canadian, French-language and 40+ international categories
- 70,000+ on-demand movies and series
- 4K Ultra HD streaming quality
- 99.9% server uptime on Canadian infrastructure
- Instant activation via WhatsApp after payment
- 24/7 customer support
- No contract, cancel anytime
- Free 24-hour trial available with no credit card required

## Pricing

- 1 Connection: CAD 26.99/month, CAD 38.99/3 months, CAD 59.99/6 months, CAD 86.99/year
- 2 Connections: CAD 34.99/month, CAD 49.99/3 months, CAD 74.99/6 months, CAD 109.99/year
- 3 Connections: CAD 42.99/month, CAD 59.99/3 months, CAD 89.99/6 months, CAD 129.99/year

## Compatible Devices

Amazon Firestick, Android TV Box, Samsung Smart TV, LG Smart TV, iPhone, iPad, Android phones, Windows PC, Mac, MAG devices. Works with IPTV Smarters, TiviMate, Edge IPTV and other popular players.

## Coverage

Primary service area: Brampton, Ontario, Canada. Also serving Mississauga, Toronto, Hamilton, Ottawa, London, Kitchener, Windsor, Scarborough, Milton and all Ontario cities. Available across all Canadian provinces.
